buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Pre-Qualification Conditions:-

A. Technical requirements:- 1. The bidder should have a valid Class “A” Electrical License Holder. 2. The bidder should have successfully completed the Turn-key/Semi-Turnkey/M&R or similar type work of the following nature in the last five financial year as prime contractor from the date of ope ning of bid part-1:- (i) Should have successfully erected and commissioned similar or higher rating work in a singl e Turn-key/Semi-Turnkey/M&R or similar type of order, having minimum order value of 60% of the estimated cost ₹5.00 Lac of present tender specification, enclosed copy. OR (ii) Should have successfully erected and commission similar or higher rating work in minimu m two Turn-key/Semi-Turnkey/ M&R or similar type of orders, having minimum order value of 40% of the estimated cost* of present tender specification, enclosed copy. OR (iii) Should have successfully erected and commissioned similar or higher rating work in minim um three Turn-key/Semi-Turnkey/ M&R or similar type of orders, having minimum order value of 30% of the estimated cost* of present tender specification, enclosed copy. B. Financial requirements:- 1. The Minimum Average Annual Turnover (MAAT) for the best three years (FYs) out of last five Financi al Years MAAT should not be less than ₹5.00 Lac (100% of the estimated cost). 2. Net Worth of the bidder should be positive. Net worth means the sum total of the paid up capital & res erves (excluding reserves created out of revaluation) reduced by aggregate value of accumulated losses (including debit balance in profit and loss account for current year) and intangible assets. 3. Solvency:- The bidder should have a minimum solvency of ₹1,25,000.00 (25% of estimated cost) or cre dit facility for the same from scheduled commercial bank. 4. The Tenderer shall have to attached copies of Income Tax Returns (ITR) / Income Tax Clearance Certifi cates for the current assessment period along with the two preceding financial years, as evidence of fina ncial standing and tax compliance. C. Required valid Character Certificate of tenderer issued from District Magistrate/ competent authority. D. The Bidder should not be blacklisted/ debarred. They have to submit an undertaking on Rs. 10/- Non-Ju dicial stamp paper. E. The Tenderer shall provide a Declaration Certificate stating that none of their family members or relative s is currently employed by the Uttar Pradesh Power Corporation Limited (UPPCL). This declaration must be submitted as a formal undertaking, duly executed on a Non-Judicial Stamp Paper of ₹10/-. F. Certified copy of GST (Goods and Services Tax) registration of the firm must be enclosed. G. Self attested copy of PAN of firm must be enclosed. H. Availability of office of service provider: An office of the Service Provider must be located in the state of Consignee. Documentary Evidence to be Submitted. I. The Bidder shall furnish a Bid Acceptance Letter, duly signed by the authorized signatory and affixed with the official seal, confirming unconditional acceptance of all the terms, conditions, specifications, and provisions of the Tender Document. The scanned copy of the duly signed and sealed Bid Acceptance Letter shall be uploaded along w ith the Technical Bid, failing which the bid may be treated as non- responsive. J. The Tenderer shall mandatorily deposit EMD ₹5000.00 @1% of Total Tender Value thro ugh DVVNL Portal (https://dvvnl.org/Loginpage.aspx) & the proof of such payment/recei pt must be enclosed along with the Tender Documents, failing which the bid shall be tr eated as non-responsive and shall be liable to be rejected. K. The bidder must only annex the documents specifically requested in the tender conditions. Inclusi on of extraneous or irrelevant documents is strictly prohibited. Failure to adhere to this instruction may result in the summary rejection of the bid. L. The Superintending Engineer reserves the right to cancel the tender without assigning any reason.

Note:- All bid-related documents/forms must be submitted online only through the GeM porta l along with the first part. No document/form will be accepted separately in the office. The d ocuments uploaded in the bid by the bidder shall be verified with the original documents as r equired by the Buyer.” TERMS AND CONDITIONS NOTE:- These terms and conditions shall be read and construed along-with the general conditions in UPPCL Form-A but in case there shall be any conflict or inconsistency between these ter ms and conditions and the conditions in UPPCL Form 'A' the provisions of these terms and conditions shall prevail. 1. Scope of work: The work of Carriage and Replacement of Damaged Transformer s of Different Capacity in EDD, Kasganj under the Jurisdiction of EDC Kasganj. The Quantity mentioned against this BOQ is final however, within the ceiling of th e agreement amount against this tender the quantity of any item can vary as p er requirement of site conditions. 2. Supervising Engineer: The concerned EE will be supervising Engineer of the work. The Supervising Engineer of the work will be responsible for supervision of work on be half of DVVNL. The work will have to be carried out in accordance with Construction M anual applicable in UPPCL and specification of work. In the event of any difference or c onflict between Contractor and DVVNL on interpretation of Terms and conditions of thi s agreement, the decision of Superintending Engineer, Electricity Distribution Ci rcle, Kasganj shall be final and binding on both parties. 3. Prices/Rates: The rates will be quoted by the Contractor as per Annexure -'A' enclose d. The rates quoted by the contractor shall remain firm in all respect. No escalation of the rates for execution of work shall be allowed during the pendency of the contract. 4. Taxes :This is a work contract as such GST shall be paid inclusive if applicable as per r ules and Income tax shall be deducted from the bills at the time of making payment. An y other tax shall be applicable as per rules. 5. As per section 171 of CGST Act 2017, Any reduction in rate of tax on any supply of goods or services or the benefit of input tax credit shall be passed on to the recipient b y way of commensurate reduction in prices. Hence supplier/manufacturer to ensure to p ass the benefit of reduced prices to DVVNL. Further price quoted by supplier/manufactu rer is subject to scrutiny under above section. 6. Material, T&P and Labour :All the material will be supplied by the department witho ut any wastage allowance as per details given in price schedule, Annexure-'A' and term s and conditions. All the T&P and labour required for proper completion of works will be arranged by the contractor at his own cost. 7. Completion of work and Penalty: The entire work of the contract will have to be co mpleted within a day from the date of handing over of complete material to be issued b y the DVVNL. The penalty for delay in completion of work shall be deducted @ half perc ent per week of incomplete/remaining works subject to the maximum ten percent. 8. Damage, loss and theft of material : If any material is damaged, lost and stolen aft er handing over the same by the JE/ASK concerned to the Contractor, its cost at stock is sue rates of UPPCL Store Organization or procurement cost will be deducted from the C ontractor claims or his legal heirs or security deposited by the contractor.

9. Variation in quantity of work: The quantity of works given in price schedule Annexu re 'A' may vary ± 50% without obtaining consent of the contractor. 10. Payment: The entire payment shall be released to the Contractor on the basis of mea surement of works executed by the Contractor against running bills of value not less tha n Rs. 10,000/- each as per terms and conditions of the contract and UPPCL Form-'A' Besi des it the work will not be stopped by the Contractor in the middle due to delay in maki ng running payment. The contractor shall submit the pre-receipted bill in duplicate to Co ncerned EE for payment and measurements. Before payment income tax clearance cert ificate must be obtained. 11. Security: The amount of security will be 10% of total value of contract shall be depos ited by the contractor before execution of agreement in the circle in the form of FDR/TD R/BG and the same shall be forfeited in case of failure of completion of work with in tim e and same shall be refunded after 6 months of the satisfactory completion of work. Sta mp shall be deposited by the contractor on security as per decision of Hon'ble Supreme Court against writ petition No. 51972/2006. 12. OTHER TERMS AND CONDITIONS:- (a) No claim shall be entertained for the labour rendered idle on any account such as du e to delay in issue of material by the DVVNL or shut down of electric line or delay in p ayment. (b) The Contractor and SDO concerned shall remain present at the time of recording th e measurements by the JE concerned. (c) The Contractor shall have to take possession of the material immediately when it is handed over by the JE/ASK concerned. (d) The Contractor shall be responsible for making payment of compensation/any other liability arised due to accident etc. of any of the labourer in terms of Compensation A ct. (e) If the contractor is found delaying the execution of work or work is not being done a ccording to the specification etc. the agreement shall be terminated without assignin g any reason and the decision of the Superintending Engineer, EDC, Kasganj sha ll be final on this issue and work shall be entrusted to other agency. Extra cost of the work as carried out by the other agency shall be debited to the Contractor account. T he security etc. will be forfeited to the UPPCL's account in case the contractor fails to complete the work. (f) The Contractor shall communicate his permanent and local address, telegraphic add ress and telephone number to the JE/SDO/EE concerned so that he may be informed of any communication to be made from time to time. (g) All disputes arising out of related to the subject matter of Contractor shall be subjec t to the jurisdiction of the local courts at Kasganj or High Court at Allahabad/Lucknow . (h) The date of start of the work shall be informed in writing to the Contractor by SDO/J E concerned. (i) Octroi charges if any shall be paid by the Contractor. (j) In case the Contractor fails to start the work his security shall be forfeited to the UPP CL's/DVVNL account. (k) The condition of Form-A of UPPCL shall be applicable and binding on the Contractor.

(l) In case the Contractor fails to execute the agreement his earnest money shall be forf eited to the UPPCL's/DVVNL account. (m) The bidder shall be strictly bound to execute the assigned works and supplies in acc ordance with the prescribed standards and technical specifications as laid down in Fo rm 'A' and Form 'B' of the UPPCL General Conditions of Contract. Any deviation from these established benchmarks without prior written approval may lead to the termina tion of the contract . 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer uploaded ATC document Click here to view the file. 3. Forms of EMD and PBG Successful Bidder can submit the Performance Security in the form of Fixed Deposit Receipt also (besides PBG which is allowed as per GeM GTC). FDR should be made out or pledged in the name of SE EDC KASGANJ A/C (Name of the Seller). The bank should certify on it that the deposit can be withdrawn only on the demand or with the sanction of the pledgee. For release of Security Deposit, the FDR will be released in favour of bidder by the Buyer after making endorsement on the back of the FDR duly signed and stamped along with covering letter. Successful Bidder has to upload scanned copy of the FDR document in place of PBG and has to ensure delivery of hard copy of Original FDR to the Buyer within 15 days of award of contract. 4. Generic OPTION CLAUSE 50% : The buyer can increase or decrease the contract quantity or contract duration up to 50 percent at the time of issue of the contract. However, once the contract is issued, the contract quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 50 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration. For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to 50 percent with the consent of the service provider
